title: iberis ciliata var. balansae
intro: Iberis ciliata var. balansae, commonly known as the Alpine Cress or Rock Cress, is a plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain and promote healing. The therapeutic actions of Iberis ciliata var. balansae include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antitumor activities, making it a potential natural remedy for infections and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
